DialogLine.Default: A treaty is a bond of honour. We have not yet seen yours tested. Ask again when we have fought beside you, or against you.

DialogLine.Friendly: I am a Klingon of the Empire. Your ship is well made. Perhaps we will meet in battle with respect, or at table with a long memory.
DialogLine.Neutral: We are Klingons. Your hull looks thin. Tell us who you are, and whether you can fight.
DialogLine.Hostile: So the galaxy holds yet more small ships with large opinions. The Klingon Empire will measure you, and it will not be gentle.

DialogLine.Friendly: Friend, many on the High Council call your settling of TARSYS an insult to the Empire. Withdraw, before they say it with disruptors.
DialogLine.Neutral: SING, your colony in TARSYS stands in our territory. It would be a fine place for your people to die. Leave.
DialogLine.Hostile: TARSYS belongs to the Empire! Who gave you the right to plant a flag there? Take it down, or we will take down you.

DialogLine.Friendly: You fire upon our ships when we thought you an ally? Where is your honour? Explain this, quickly.
DialogLine.Neutral: You strike one Klingon ship and forget the rest of the fleet, SING. Remember it now. Be wary.
DialogLine.Hostile: Cowardly PLURAL! Your aggression will be answered in blood, and the Empire does not forget a debt.

DialogLine.Friendly: Your warships linger at our border, friend. We would like to trust you, but our captains grow restless. Withdraw.
DialogLine.Neutral: Your ships sit in Klingon space. Our young captains hunger for glory, and you offer it to them. Leave now.
DialogLine.Hostile: PLURAL ships in Klingon space! You come to die, it seems. Leave, or give our captains the battle they crave.

DialogLine.Friendly: We told you to leave our space. We wished to remain friends. Now you take TARSYS. Do not mistake our patience for weakness.
DialogLine.Neutral: We warned you, and you ignored us, and now you settle TARSYS. Your people have a poor idea of how to survive.
DialogLine.Hostile: You trespassed in our borders, were warned, and took TARSYS anyway. The Empire will answer with ships and blades.

DialogLine.Friendly: You settled TARSYS and we kept the peace, and now your fleet sits in our space. Our patience wears thin.
DialogLine.Neutral: First you took TARSYS from us, and now your ships crowd our worlds. You are asking for war.
DialogLine.Hostile: First TARSYS, now a fleet in our territory. The Empire will not be tested twice. Prepare to fight.

Dialogs.DialogLine: Declare War Qapla'! There will be war! Your worlds will soon fly the banner of the Empire! Run if you must. A Klingon enjoys a good chase, and a better kill.>

DialogLine.Friendly: nuqneH. It is you. What do you want? Speak plainly.
DialogLine.Neutral: You come before the Empire. State your business, and make it worth our time.
DialogLine.Hostile: Speak, if you have the courage, or be silent and leave.

DialogLine.Default: There are others like you out there? Good. A galaxy with more warriors in it is a better one. We have not met them.

DialogLine.DL_Xeno: You wish to know the Klingons? We are the Empire, heirs of Kahless. What you are matters little to us, unless you can fight.
DialogLine.DL_Agg: You wish to know the Klingons? We are warriors, born to battle. If you do not fear us, you should.
DialogLine.DL_Ruth: You wish to know the Klingons? Weakness is a disease, and the Empire is the cure. We will rid the quadrant of it, one world at a time.
DialogLine.DL_Exp: There are many worlds yet to take, and the Empire has the ships to take them. Glory waits for those who reach for it.
DialogLine.DL_Mil: Look upon our fleet, and know what the Empire can do. A thousand ships, and every captain eager for battle.
DialogLine.DL_Ind: The Empire's strength is not only in our blades. Our forges and mines never rest, and every warrior goes to battle well armed.
DialogLine.DL_Gen: The great houses of the Empire are both wise and strong, swift and tough. A Klingon who is only one of those is not truly Klingon.

DialogLine.Default: Your crew looks strong. Do they fight as well as they look?
Hmph. We will see on the field of battle.
No. We do not trust a bargain with a stranger.
Ha! You give far more than you ask. Either you fear us or you are a fool. We accept, and you may offer more like it.
No. You think we are fools, and you do not even offer us a fair price. We reject it.
We respect you enough to be honest: this offer is an insult. Make a better one.
Another power holds worlds in that system, SING, and we have no borders open with them. We will not have your fleet leaving ours exposed.
DialogLine.DL_Agg: The Empire picks its own wars. Do not try to pick them for us.
DialogLine.DL_Xeno: Outsiders meddling on our borders. We knew you could not be trusted.
DialogLine.DL_Hon: To set neighbours against each other is dishonourable. We expected better of you.
DialogLine.DL_Pac: You would start a war between us and our neighbours? That angers us.
DialogLine.DL_Ruth: A clever scheme, but it is the Empire that sets others against each other. Remember that.
DialogLine.DL_Cunn: We see the trap you have laid. We will trust you far less from now on.

DialogLine.Default: Our enemies hold worlds in that system, SING. A Klingon takes his enemy's worlds in battle, not across a table.
DialogLine.DL_Agg: When the Empire wants worlds there, it will take them from our enemies by force.
DialogLine.DL_Xeno: The Empire needs no outsiders' worlds to fight its wars.
DialogLine.DL_Hon: We will not put your settlers in the middle of our war, but we thank you for the thought.
DialogLine.DL_Pac: We hope to end that war, not to spread it. We thank you all the same.
DialogLine.DL_Ruth: Their worlds will be ours soon enough, by our own hand.
DialogLine.DL_Cunn: A world on the front line is a burden, not a prize. Perhaps another time.

DialogLine.Default: This is an insult to the Empire! No!
This arrangement serves the Empire. It is agreed.
A good bargain. The Empire is stronger for it. Agreed.
You give us far more than you receive. A wise PLURAL, or a frightened one. Either way, we accept.
Tribute. Good. The Empire accepts it.
We will take these scraps. But next time, bring us something worthy of Klingons.
You want this from us? Come and take it, if you can.
Very well. The Empire has no need to fight you over so little.
A poor bargain, forced upon us. We will remember it. Take your spoils.
PLURAL fools! We were going to come for you anyway. It is war, then, and today is a good day to fight it.
We are at war. Speak quickly, and then let our ships speak.
You bring your ships to our border to fight, and we will meet them with ours. Let the best fleet win.
We never trusted a paper treaty over a blade. Now you have broken it, and we will break you.
We warned you not to enter Klingon territory, and you came regardless. You have chosen war.
PLURAL dare to stay in TARSYS, when it is Klingon territory? Then we are at war!
The Empire has no wish to fight you today. Swear a non-aggression pact, and we will consider it.
Good. A wise choice. We will honour it, as long as you do.
You refuse? Then you may wish for this treaty later. It will not be offered twice.
The Empire makes the finest weapons in the quadrant. Trade with us, and see for yourself.
Good. Trade well and we will be friends. Trade badly and we will not.
You refuse the Empire's trade? PLURAL are fools. Remember who offered.
First you refuse a pact, and now you want one? Make up your mind, PLURAL, before we make it up for you.
You refused trade before. Now you ask for it. Are you trying to trick us?
Give us TECH_DEMAND, or we will not call you a friend.
Good. You are not as weak as you look.
You refuse us? Then we will take it from you.
Ha! The PLURAL fleet is a joke. When we get around to conquering you, it will be a short battle.
Your fleet is strong. Perhaps we should pick an easier opponent. Perhaps not.
You have strengthened your fleet. Good. A strong enemy makes victory worth singing.
You are too weak to hold your worlds, SING. The Empire will take them for you.
The Humans fought beside the Empire when it mattered. They talk too much, but they have teeth, and we respect that.
The Humans talk a great deal and fight less than they speak. They are not our enemy, and not quite our friend.
Humans lecture the Empire on peace while standing behind our guns. We have no use for their sermons.
The Pollops sing, and their songs are old and good. A people with such memory understand honour. We like them.
We know the Pollops little. They are a quiet people of the green, and they have not troubled the Empire.
The Pollops talk of harmony while their worlds lie open for the taking. Their songs will not defend them.
The Kulrathi Shogunate lives by a warrior's code, as we do. We know what a blade and a bond are worth. They are good company.
The Kulrathi keep to their codes and their shogun. We watch them, and they watch us. That is a fair arrangement for now.
The Kulrathi believe they are the Empire's equal. Let them test it in battle, and they will learn.
The Cordrazine Collective is strong, and we respect strength. We would be glad to see how well it fights.
We do not know the Cordrazine well. They keep to their Collective, and the Empire keeps to its own.
The Cordrazine hide behind their Collective like cowards behind a crowd. Let them stand alone and see how brave they are.
You thought a treaty would stop the Klingon Empire? Words are for lawyers. Today we answer with ships.
It is done! The PLURAL are broken, and the Empire stands victorious. You have lost, SING. Die well, or live in shame.
The PLURAL have shown us respect, and we have no reason to fight you. Let our ships pass freely, and we will do the same.
Good. A wise choice. Our ships will pass in peace, unless you give us a reason.
You refuse an open road? A cautious PLURAL, or a fearful one. Soon it will be too late to ask.
We held a pact with you, and you broke it! A Klingon does not forgive betrayal. War!
TARSYS is ours! You have invaded Klingon space. This means war!
The Opteris fight without fear, machine and insect alike. It is a good enemy, and a good friend to have at one's side.
The Opteris are strange to us. Insects and machines. We do not understand them, and we are not eager to try.
The Opteris are cold machines that feel nothing, and there is no honour in killing them. Still, we will break them.

DialogLine.Friendly: Friend, the Empire has claimed TARSYS. Stay out of it, and we will remain on good terms.
DialogLine.Neutral: TARSYS is claimed by the Empire. Stay out, or you will answer to our fleet.
DialogLine.Hostile: TARSYS belongs to the Klingon Empire, PLURAL. Come near it, and you will be met with blades.

DialogLine.Default: We have only just met the PLURAL. Show us how you fight, and then we will tell you what we think.
We have no quarrel with the PLURAL. You have treated the Empire with respect, and we remember it.
We have problems with you, PLURAL. We will name them, and then we will settle them.
You have taken worlds that belong to the Empire! We will have them back.
You have taken worlds that belong to the Empire! We will have them back.
Your fleet has grown too large. Any warrior would grow uneasy at a rival with so many ships.
Your fleet is small and weak, and a weak ally is a poor one. Make it stronger.
Your fleet is weak. The Empire does not ally with a people who cannot defend themselves.
Your fleet is too large. The Empire does not like a rival with so many ships.
You are allied with TAREMP, who are enemies of the Empire. Choose your friends with more care.
You are still allied with TAREMP, who are enemies of the Empire. We take notice of it.
We have no great quarrel with you. Do not give us one.
You can run, SING, but you cannot hide forever. Speak, if you have breath left to spare!
We are at war, and the fight is not over. Speak quickly.
TAREMP are enemies of the Empire. Fight with us, and share the glory.
Qapla'! We will fight together. Death to TAREMP!
You will not fight beside us? Then do not expect us to bleed for you, PLURAL.
The Draylok Council changes shape and plans in the shadows. But they keep their word to us, and we repay it in kind.
The Draylok shift their faces and their loyalties. We do not trust them, but we have no quarrel with them yet.
The Draylok hide behind shifting faces and councils. A warrior shows his face, and they have none. We despise them.
This war has taken enough blood for now. We will make peace, if you will.
We are winning this war, but the High Council thinks it should end for now. Make peace with us.
We fight, and you fight, and neither side wins. There is no honour in a war without end. We should make peace.
You have beaten us this time. We will make peace, if you will. Do not mistake it for surrender.
Keep your planets and give us peace. For now.
We hold your worlds. Sign this treaty, and the war will end.
Good. We did not want peace anyway.
Very well. We will have peace. May it be a good rest between battles.
A good offer. We accept. There will be peace between us.
No peace. Your offer is an insult.
You still hold lands the Empire wants. There will be no peace.
We will make this peace, and we are not happy with it. Do not waste it.
We made war on you, and you are still standing. That is not forgotten.
The Klingon Empire and the PLURAL have fought well, and respect each other. Let us make an alliance.
Good! The Empire will stand beside you, and expects the same.
So you do not wish to stand with the Empire? We will think on that.
This is too confusing! If you want an alliance, offer us an alliance, plainly.
Good! We will be your allies, and we will fight beside you.
You call yourselves our friends? You have not earned it.
No! There will be no peace until your fleet is broken!
No blood has been shed between us, and no fleet destroyed. Very well. We will have peace.
You made a pact with us, and now you break it? That is dishonour! It is war!
You will not fight beside us? Then you are no ally of the Empire. The alliance is ended.
TARSYS was ours! The Empire claimed it first, and you took it. You will pay.
Twice now you have crossed the Empire. Few live to do it once. Do not make it three times.
Too many times you have stolen from the Empire! Your death will be slow.
The Ralyeh Devoted live for their faith, and a Klingon honours devotion. They do not bother us, and we do not bother them.
The Ralyeh keep to their faith and their waters. They are no concern of the Empire.
The Ralyeh preach and pray while others fight for them. Their faith will not stop a disruptor.
We know you spy on us. The Empire has nothing to hide from the brave, but we do not forgive spies. Stop.
We warned you to stop spying. Do the PLURAL not listen? It will not be said a third time.
You spy on us again! We are done with you. All treaties between us are ended.
We caught your spy, and gave him an honest death. He was not worth the trouble.
A spy among our allies? We caught your agent. Are we friends or not? Stop it.
You spy on us again, ally? We are no longer friends. Our alliance is ended.
Open your borders to us, SING. Friends should not stand at each other's gates.
You keep your borders closed to your friends? The PLURAL are very wary.
We have only just met. A Klingon does not swear to a banner he has never seen in battle.
We are not yet allied. First an alliance, then perhaps something more. Allies first.
We are allies now. This is good. But a bond must be tested over time, and we want to see how it holds.
Why would we follow you? The Empire is stronger. It is you who should join us.
You ask the Empire to stand with you? Yes. We agree. From today, PLURAL and Klingons fight as one house. Qapla'!
You want the Empire at your side? Prove yourself in battle. Destroy TAREMP, and we will stand with you.
TAREMP is destroyed. You have proved yourself a warrior. The Empire joins your federation, with honour.
You want the Empire to follow you? We do not even like you!
We will join you, but first you must ally with our friends, TAREMP. Win their trust, and then speak to us again.
You have made friends of our friends. A good sign. The Empire will join your federation.
You are not even at war with TAREMP. Why would the Empire fight for you? Do the PLURAL think us fools?
We are already at war with TAREMP. Were you not paying attention, PLURAL?
We will always fight beside our allies. Death to TAREMP!
We are allied with TAREMP. A Klingon does not break his word, even for a friend. I am sorry.
Why should we fight for you, PLURAL? When TAREMP is done with you, perhaps we will pick through what is left.
I cannot believe I am saying this, but we will not make war on TAREMP. We have had enough of battle, for now.
TAREMP is very strong. A wise warrior chooses his battles. We will not fight them yet.
TAREMP are worthy foes. We will fight them with you. Qapla'!
The High Council doubts that you can be trusted as an ally, SING. Give them a reason to think otherwise.
The High Council has revoked our open borders. We no longer trust your empire to keep them.
